## Problem and change

Explain the user-visible problem and the smallest change that addresses it. Link a related issue if one exists.

## Verification

List the exact checks run and their results. Identify failed, skipped, or unrun checks separately. For UI changes, add screenshots without private content.

## Compatibility and documentation

- [ ] I checked whether this changes configuration, persisted data, or public behavior.
- [ ] I updated applicable documentation and translations, or explained why none are needed.
- [ ] I removed credentials and private data from code, fixtures, logs, and screenshots.

## Remaining work

List known limitations. Keep the pull request in draft if work or verification is incomplete.
